name: eBay wholesale drop-ship listings

product.purpose: Prepare local eBay Sell Inventory API listing drafts from a wholesale supplier CSV and owner-reviewed supplier purchase order drafts from eBay Fulfillment API orders.
product.policy: Only direct fulfillment by a wholesale supplier with seller responsibility for on-time delivery and buyer satisfaction. No retailer or marketplace sourcing.
product.publication: Inventory and offer API writes require explicit owner approval and a durable Glacier audit-event writer. Publishing each offer requires a separate explicit owner approval. This build never calls the publish endpoint.
product.billing: No spending or subscription is authorized. Every supplier PO remains an unsent owner-approved draft.

your_steps.title: Verify eBay payouts and set up developer access
your_steps.when: Before using live eBay Sell APIs
your_steps.detail: In one setup sitting, verify the seller identity and payout account in eBay Seller Center, then join/sign in to the eBay Developer Program, create a Sandbox keyset and a Production keyset when ready, and authorize Sell Inventory and Fulfillment scopes through eBay OAuth. Save the user token only in Glacier Settings → Secrets as ebay_user_access_token. Follow OWNER-STEPS.md. Estimate 25–45 minutes when records are ready.

your_steps.title: Submit the prefilled supplier applications
your_steps.when: Before adding supplier products to listing drafts
your_steps.detail: In a separate sitting, use research/SUPPLIER-APPLICATIONS.md to submit written applications/inquiries to Mammoth Attachments, Medal Equipment, and Wholesale By Travers. Replace only OWNER-marked fields using business records; submit each yourself. Wait for written permission for eBay sales, dropship, product-data/images, costs, stock and lead times. For qualifying tax-free resale purchases, provide a completed Georgia Form ST-5 only after valid sales-tax registration, as described in the packet. Estimated 25–35 minutes, plus any required tax registration time.

launch_gates: Owner has reviewed current eBay drop-shipping, automation, listing, delivery, and API terms.
The Apify sold-listings query pack is not run until eBay permission or another documented eBay-approved access basis is recorded; owner authorization of Apify does not grant permission from eBay.
Live Sell API writes are routed through a durable Glacier audit-event writer before the network call.
Every listing has a wholesale supplier agreement permitting marketplace resale and direct-to-buyer shipment.
Supplier lead times, inventory, outbound freight, returns, and warranty terms are verified before listing.
Every eBay inventory/offer write, listing publication, supplier PO, and payment is separately approved by the owner.
